tooltip.wraith_cannon.mode_mist: Hold right click · Charge and spray
wraith_cannon.configuration.melee.cooldo: Ticks of cooldown applied after a melee hit; right-click charging is blocked meanwhile. 0 = no limit. 20 ticks = 1 second.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.chargeT: How long right-click must be held to fully charge. Default 30 ticks = 1.5 s.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.cooldow: Cooldown after firing the mist. Default 25 ticks.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.reachBl: Maximum distance from the eye to the front of the mist. Default 27 blocks (about 9x a sword).
Damage when a target is hit by the head of the mist. Each target takes only the highest tier per shot (direct > graze).
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.grazeDa: Damage to targets inside the spray corridor but missed by the head. Once per target per shot.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.tickDam: Damage dealt every 0.5 s (10 ticks) to targets standing inside the lingering mist.
Strength of the recoil impulse after firing. 0 = none, default 0.4 is a slight push, max 3.0. Horizontal recoil points opposite to your aim and weakens as the shot nears vertical (up to -70%). See "Vertical recoil multiplier" and "Water recoil multiplier" for the rest.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.vertica: Vertical impulse = Recoil x this value x pitch curve. Default 0.8; 0 disables vertical recoil. On land only near-vertical shots have vertical recoil: zero while |pitch| is below the pitch threshold, then ramping up smoothly to the maximum at about 85 degrees. Shooting down pushes you up; shooting up pushes you down. In water there is no threshold: the curve is linear in sin(pitch).
On land there is no vertical recoil while |pitch| is below this value (degrees, default 70, range 60-80). Lower values trigger vertical recoil more easily.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.waterRe: While in water, the whole recoil (horizontal + vertical) is multiplied by this value to simulate water drag. Default 0.4; 1.0 = same as on land, 0 = no recoil in water.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.cloudSe: Total lifetime of the mist in seconds, including the 1 s jet phase. Default 3 s.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.cloudRa: Maximum radius of the mist in blocks. Larger is easier to hit with.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.headRat: Direct-hit radius = cloud radius x this value. 1.0 = the whole cloud counts as the head; lower values require more precise aim.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.grazeRa: Graze corridor radius = cloud radius x this value. Default 2. 0 disables grazing. Capped at 32 blocks and never smaller than the direct-hit radius.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.grazeFo: The graze corridor widens from the muzzle and reaches full width after this many blocks. Default 4 keeps close pets and allies safe. 0 = no ramp.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.pierceM: How far the mist can travel inside solid blocks (measured along the ray, so clipping a corner only counts a little). Beyond it, the mist is stopped. 0 = no piercing. Range is also reduced by the pierce range loss; set that to 0 for near-zero attenuation.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.pierceR: Range removed for every block of length travelled through solid blocks. Default 6; 0 = no loss.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.sparePe: Pets tamed by the shooter take no damage from the mist. Enabled by default.
wraith_cannon.configuration.mist.wallOve: Offset of the mist's front edge from its stop point. Positive extends it, negative pulls it back. 0 = stops exactly at the wall face. Applies to all shots, not only wall-blocked ones.
wraith_cannon.configuration.feel.chargeZ: FOV reduction at full charge. 0 = none; 0.15 equals the vanilla bow and is the maximum. Also scaled by the FOV Effects accessibility slider.
wraith_cannon.configuration.feel.muzzleC: Degrees the camera kicks upward after firing. 0 = none; default 5, max 15. Client-side only.
wraith_cannon.configuration.held.slowEna: Whether holding it in the main hand applies Slowness. When off, the next two options have no effect.
wraith_cannon.configuration.held.slowAmp: Slowness level while held: 0 = Slowness I, 1 = Slowness II, and so on. To remove it entirely, turn off "Slowness while held".
wraith_cannon.configuration.held.hideSlo: Hide the particles from the held Slowness effect. Hidden by default.
wraith_cannon.configuration.weapon.attac: Bonus melee damage; the displayed total is 1 + this value (default 9, shows 10). Requires a game restart; keep client and server identical.
Swings per second. Default 1.0, the same as a vanilla axe. Requires a game restart; keep client and server identical.
wraith_cannon.configuration.weapon.durab: Total durability; each mist shot costs 1. Default 1500. Requires a game restart; keep client and server identical.
